name: hydro-dmrv
description: Digital MRV for run-of-river hydropower: a 5-layer verifier anchors reports on HCS, a Solidity registry mints HTS RECs (1 token = 1 MWh), and a Chainlink HBAR/USD feed settles USD-priced sales in HBAR. Ships an MCP server so AI agents can verify, audit and trade.

steps.text: Hydro dMRV composes HCS (audit trail), HTS (REC token created by the contract) and a Chainlink HBAR/USD feed (USD-priced settlement). README.md walks through the whole flow; AGENTS.md briefs coding agents.

sections.title: Try it locally (no Hedera account needed)

steps.label: Deploy HydroREC, a mock oracle and the demo plant
Put hederaLocalFork first in packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts, then start the app
Import its key as the deployer
Deploy (creates the HTS token and prints Hashscan links)
Verify, anchor and mint a day of generation
